brand-green.note: Dark mode lifts lightness and chroma and puts dark text (--primary-foreground) on it; 7.5:1 as text on the dark card. Near Tailwind emerald-700 (0.508 0.118 165.612) with lower chroma.

page-zinc.note: The only hex in globals.css. Dark value is translucent over the browser's dark canvas (color-scheme: dark is set on <html>); the effective colour was not measured.

muted-ink.note: Light value was darkened from zinc-500 (0.552, 4.4:1) to 0.53 (4.8:1 on the page) for AA; no longer a pure zinc stop.

headline.purpose: Page h1 on Models, Groups, Keys, Settings (1.5rem below 40rem, 1.875rem from sm). Once per page.

headline-compact.purpose: h1 of a single key's page (1.25rem below 40rem, 1.5rem from sm).

title.purpose: h2 section headings and shelf titles, with a muted count beside them.

title-dialog.purpose: DialogTitle; leading-none, sits above a muted text-sm description.

card-title.purpose: Model, group or key name inside a card header; clamped to two lines, underlined on hover.

body.purpose: Running text and field values (inputs are 1rem below 48rem).

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, tabs, toggle segments.

caption.purpose: Secondary metadata, counts, reason lines, tooltips. The floor: nothing needed to act goes below 12px.

overline.purpose: Uppercase section heads in the capability comparison panel (Input / Output / Features) only.

mono.purpose: Model IDs, native IDs, endpoints. Long IDs use truncate-start so the distinctive tail survives.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-sm: base Card and CatalogCard at rest, sticky key-draft panel. A whisper beside the 1px border.

shadows.name: segment-edge
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-xs: outline Toggle only (2 uses).

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-md: popover, select menu, dropdown, tooltip.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-lg: Dialog, Sheet, Switch thumb. Sits over a rgb(0 0 0 / 50%) scrim.

shadows.name: focus-ring-button
shadows.purpose: Button focus-visible (ring-1 ring-offset-1 ring-primary/50). Outline variant uses --ring/50, ghost uses --accent-foreground/30. The offset gap is Tailwind's default #fff.

shadows.name: focus-ring-solid
shadows.purpose: Card-name buttons, capability triggers, tab panel, sheet header buttons (ring-2 ring-ring).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Tailwind default for every transition-* utility (hover colours, border shifts).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button :active feedback. The only tactile flourish.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.value: colors 150ms; border to primary/40; none under prefers-reduced-motion

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.value: 100ms ease-in-out slide from the right edge

motion.name: sidebar-width
motion.purpose: Sidebar collapse to icon rail (15rem to 3.25rem).

breakpoints.name: viewport-md
breakpoints.value: 48rem (768px): persistent sidebar, inset content card with rounded-md and 2.5rem side padding, inputs drop to 0.875rem

breakpoints.name: viewport-xl
breakpoints.value: 80rem (1280px): Expert switch appears; Expert key composer splits into editor + draft panel (also hard-coded as min-width: 1280px in App.tsx)

breakpoints.name: container-md
breakpoints.value: 28rem: catalog grid goes from 1 to 2 columns

breakpoints.name: container-2xl
breakpoints.value: 42rem: 3 columns; filters, Vue / Forme / Densité fold into Filtres (n) and Options d'affichage below this width

breakpoints.name: content-max
breakpoints.value: 90rem: max width of the main column

narrative.overview:
Registry looks like the Bifrost dashboard it sits beside, tightened into a calm zinc workbench. Information sits in white, hairline-bordered cards on a cool zinc page, and nothing competes with the facts: visual weight goes to names and counts, never to chrome. A ledger is ruled rows read top to bottom, one entry per thing, and that is the shape of the interface, from a key's single register with one row per model to a catalogue of cards that all share one fixed anatomy. The mood is sober, exact and unhurried.

Colour is rationed by job. One emerald marks what you can act on; teal and amber report state; red is reserved for errors and for steps that change Bifrost. Everything else is zinc. Type is Geist at 12 to 14px, controls are 36px (32px compact) with 4px corners, and a selected state is told by tone plus a 1px outline rather than by a new colour. Light and dark are the same layout with re-anchored lightness, and Basic and Expert change how much detail is shown, not how it looks.

The accepted style is a fixed constraint, not a variable: no new colour, radius or component is introduced. Visual rejections already confirmed by the owner: capability variants drawn as circles or diamonds, the first grouped capability panel, the earlier `ReferenceCatalogBrowser` render, the home-made components of the Hermes prototype, variable-height Grid cards and a scrolling Square body, and a permanent red Delete button on a card.
keyCharacteristics: Cool zinc page, white cards, one 1px hairline: tone first, border second.
One emerald for action only; teal and amber for state; red for errors and Bifrost-changing steps.
4px corners everywhere except the 8px Dialog and the 6px inset content card.
Geist at 12 to 14px, Geist Mono for identifiers only, nothing needed to act below 12px.
36px controls, 32px compact; selected state by tone plus a 1px outline.
Columns and folded controls follow the container width; design floor 375px, no horizontal scroll.
Light and dark share one layout; dark lifts the emerald and puts dark text on it.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Settled Emerald marks what the operator can act on, and only that. It is the default Button, the link, the focus border, the active tab and the active nav entry; it never reports a state. Its rarity on a screen is what makes it readable.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Settled Emerald (hue 165.6) and Verified Teal (hue 182) are different greens with different jobs: emerald is action, teal is state. Never swap them, and never add a third green.

rules.name: The No New Colour Rule
rules.body: The UI contract is explicit: no new colour. New emphasis is an existing token at an opacity step already in use (the card hover border is emerald at 40%, selected and warning tints are 5%, the warning border is 50%).

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Running text is 14px or 16px; secondary metadata is 12px. Nothing needed to act on is ever set at 10 or 11px.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for identifiers only: model IDs, native model names, endpoints. Long IDs truncate at the start so the distinctive tail survives.

rules.name: The Container Rule
rules.body: Columns, folded controls and any internal split follow the width of the container the component sits in, never the window alone; this is what keeps a resized panel correct.

rules.name: The One Scroll Rule
rules.body: An editor, dialog or sheet has exactly one scrolling container, and its footer stays visible. At 375px the decisions come first.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Every Card carries the card-rest shadow, so the system is not flat at rest, but it is not lifted either. Plain bordered sections built directly (the key ledger) carry the hairline alone. Do not stack more shadow on a card.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: A visible shadow means "this floats". Popover weight for small floating layers, modal weight for dialogs and sheets, nothing in between.

rules.name: The Border Carries State Rule
rules.body: Hover moves a card border to emerald at 40%; selected is a teal border with a 5% tint; warning is an amber border at 50% with a 5% tint; a pressed Button scales down 1%. State never arrives as a glow, a lift or a new shadow.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Corners are 4px unless this section names the exception. Do not introduce 12px or 16px "friendly" radii; the contract adds no new radius.

rules.name: The Tone-Plus-Outline Rule
rules.body: A selected segment is told by Pale Zinc Wash fill, a 1px Quiet Zinc Ink outline and full-strength text, with the unselected ones at Quiet Zinc Ink. It never gets a new colour.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Each view leads with one default emerald Button. Every other action is outline or ghost, and the only red button is a confirming step.

dos: Do reserve Settled Emerald for action: the default Button, links, the input focus border, the active tab and the active nav entry, with one default Button leading each view.
Do colour state from the `--chart-*` tokens: Verified Teal for selected, verified and fresh; Caution Amber at a 50% border and 5% tint for warnings; Caution Amber Ink for 12px reason text.
Do build every surface from the existing tokens, and make new emphasis an existing token at an opacity step already in use (40%, 50%, 5%).
Do use 4px corners, 36px controls and 32px compact controls, and keep the standard Button at least as tall as the compact one.
Do give every card the same anatomy: identity in the header, facts in the body, provider and actions in the footer, one hairline between body and footer.
Do mark a selected segment with the Pale Zinc Wash fill, a 1px Quiet Zinc Ink outline and Blue-Black Zinc Ink text.
Do size columns and folded controls from the container: 28rem, 42rem and 56rem for 2, 3 and 4 columns.
Do keep text needed to act at 12px or larger, secondary text at Quiet Zinc Ink, and pair a colour with text or an icon so meaning never rests on colour alone.
Do keep a visible focus ring or border on every interactive element, and return focus to the trigger after a sheet, dialog or popover closes.
Do set Geist Mono on identifiers only, and truncate long IDs at the start.
Do label any step that edits Bifrost with the destructive "Changes Bifrost" badge, and keep that step's button outline until the final confirm.
Do give new transitions a reduced-motion fallback, as the CatalogCard does.
donts: Don't add a colour, a radius or a component; the accepted style is a fixed constraint.
Don't use Settled Emerald for state or Verified Teal for action, and don't add a third green.
Don't colour new status UI with raw Tailwind palette values (green, yellow, emerald, amber); status colours come from the `--chart-*` state tokens.
Don't use red for anything but errors, the destructive Button and the "Changes Bifrost" label, and never as a permanent Delete button on a card.
Don't draw capability variants as circles or diamonds, tint capability icons, or bring back the first grouped capability panel.
Don't take the earlier `ReferenceCatalogBrowser` render or the Hermes prototype's home-made components as a reference.
Don't let Grid cards vary in height with their content or let a Square card scroll inside; Square is a true 1:1.
Don't set anything needed to act at 10 or 11px.
Don't print the page title twice.
Don't add coloured shadows, glows or lift on hover; state lives in the border and a tint.
Don't give an editor, dialog or sheet a second scroll container.
Don't drive a component's internal layout from the window width alone.
